quantization: Affine grouped weight-only, group_size64; Q4 and Q8 derived from same cached FP16 export, KV remains floating. Q8 is NOT FP8.
quality: One complete DEV evaluation (74 rows) per variant, same decoder/config/hardware. No old test or cross-article holdout inference. Repeated dev use means exploratory candidate selection, not independent quality confirmation.
workload: Same first 8 frozen TRAIN pilot prompts, forced32 tokens regardlessEOS, batch1, 2 synthetic warmups per fresh process. 3 runs/variant, serial. Compare same-round medians, retain every run.
decision: All gates must pass relative to same-round FP16 to qualify as a local dev-only compression candidate. Passing does not make the underlying QA model deployable or prove independent test quality. No automatic adoption/publication.
budget: One Q8 conversion, Q8 decoder parity check on2train rows, 3dev runs,9bench processes. No hyperparameter retry, no paid API, no network/download.
